crew.base.energy.text: Each living crew consumes 3054/24 = 127.25 game kcal per tick from personal food_energy.

crew.base.water.text: Each living crew consumes 3.217/24 L personal water per tick; this is the fixed game baseline.

crew.base.oxygen.text: Each living crew consumes 0.895*1000/24 OU from public oxygen per tick.

crew.personal.death.text: Personal food_energy or water <= 0 means death; no revival. Any crew death fails the mission.

crew.refill.transfer.text: Transfer min(request, per-action cap, public stock, personal headroom), in Core refill_order. Caps: eat 1000, drink 0.5. No double metabolism charge.

crew.task.exclusive.text: Exactly one occupying task per crew per tick, even when actual refill or work is zero. Core alone decides schedules.

world.oxygen.death.text: Public oxygen <= 0 kills all living crew immediately; later plant oxygen cannot rescue them.

public.threshold.text: Public low thresholds are warnings, not reserves subtracted from stock. Public food, water or power zero does not directly kill crew.

generation.proportional.text: a_i=min(request_i,1,energy_after_base_i/100); A=sum(a_i); W=min(A,oxygen/25,power_headroom/250); w_i=W*a_i/A. Consume 100 personal kcal and 25 public OU per work, produce 250 EU. Exact exhaustion is fatal.

water_production.conversion.text: Actual L=min(request,250,power/2,oxygen/0.2,water_headroom). Consume 2 EU and 0.2 OU per L. Unknown availability stays unknown. This is a game abstraction, not a physical conservation claim.

plant.irrigation.atomic.text: Core orders allocations. A living plot needs full 8.7 L and 5 EU atomically; otherwise neither is deducted and failure counter increases once. Third failure kills plant before harvest. Mature plants still require supply.

plant.harvest.text: Only a successful full-plot harvest adds food, subject to full capacity. Human does not execute crop operations or anticipate harvest credit.

tick.order.text: refill -> base/respiration -> generation -> water_production -> irrigation/oxygen -> crop operations. Stop after any crew death. Human coverage ends before crop operations; not an authoritative world state.
